//: Tier -> { model, thinking } map. THIS IS THE ONLY FILE TO EDIT WHEN MODELS CHANGE.
Each persona declares a tier (fast|balanced|strong|deep) in its own file; this maps tiers
to provider models; each host adapts their spelling while the roster grows.
'model:thinking' shorthand is accepted and normalized. Thinking is stored apart
from the model because hosts spell it differently: pi appends ':level', while
Claude Code has no per-agent equivalent and drops it.
Edit via: staffed tier strong --model X --thinking high
Select defaults with: staffed tier --profile openai (or anthropic or openai-deepseek)
'unverified' lists tiers seeded by guesswork; declaring one clears its entry.
Check your own install with: staffed doctor
